title: Expose the v5 VoxelDocument writer in the VIXEN codegen target
body: VIXEN regeneration did not produce the v5 VoxelDocument writer. This lane had to create a detached kernel worktree, build and run the kernel VoxelDocumentEmitterTests, then manually copy the generated header into VIXEN/libraries/SVO/include/Recipe/generated/VoxelDocument.g.h. Suggested consolidation: make the consumer codegen target invoke the pinned kernel writer emitter and add a VIXEN regen/check target for the artifact.

title: Generate typed layer-port metadata and lowering for VIXEN
body: EditorDocumentModel had to hand-write InferPortKind name heuristics and ReadPort flattening because the generated VIXEN surface exposes opcodes and wire bytes but no declarative port catalogue or port-valued argument lowering. Suggested consolidation: emit typed layer-port declarations, matching-port queries, and generated read/default lowering from the kernel facade so consumers do not infer types from strings.

title: Make generated graph additions warning-clean for VIXEN consumers
body: After moving the VIXEN kernel pin to the set-ops wave, generated graph aggregate rows gained fields and generated SDF opcodes gained document-only values. The consumer needed a PUBLIC -Wno-missing-field-initializers compatibility flag and a handwritten default/assert in SdfRecipeEval.h to keep the legacy evaluator exhaustive. Suggested consolidation: update the emitter's legacy aggregate initializers and emit a consumer-facing evaluator partition/default contract.
